title: candidate_committee_link
description: One link between a candidate and a committee in a cycle, from the FEC's candidate-committee linkage file (and, before 2000, which has none, from the master files). Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

committee_type.description: The FEC committee type of the committee.

designation.description: The FEC committee designation of the link (`P` principal, `A` authorized …).

linkage_id.description: The FEC's id of the link; null for a link read from the master files.
